from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

def calc_mw(seq):
    return ProteinAnalysis(seq).molecular_weight()

for acc in ["Q155Q3", "Q9NVH1"]:
    fasta = urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta?includeIsoform=true").read().decode()
    for entry in fasta.split(">"):
        if entry.strip():
            header = entry.strip().split("\n")[0]
            seq = "".join(entry.strip().split("\n")[1:])
            mw = calc_mw(seq)
            print(f"{header[:30]}... len={len(seq)}, MW={mw:.1f} Da ({mw/1000:.2f} kDa)")

import urllib.request
import json

def get_refseq_proteins(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=protein&term=Homo+sapiens[orgn]+AND+{gene_symbol}[gene]+AND+refseq[filter]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    ids = data['esearchresult']['idlist']
    
    summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(ids[:10])}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(summary_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        sum_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    for pid in ids[:10]:
        title = sum_data['result'][pid]['title']
        slen = sum_data['result'][pid]['slen']
        print(f"  {pid}: {title} (len={slen})")

print("DIXDC1 RefSeqs:")
get_refseq_proteins("DIXDC1")
print("\nDNAJC11 RefSeqs:")
get_refseq_proteins("DNAJC11")
